name: Summer Explorations
description_short: Summer program on the Elisabeth Morrow School's 14 acre wooded campus in Englewood for age 2 through grade 9, half day (8:30 to 12:15) or full day (8:30 to 3:15). Young children have theme weeks in small classes, grades 2 to 6 pick weekly workshops in science, art, technology, drama and sports, and grades 7 to 9 have a three week Leaders in Training course.

sessions.name: Specialized week: AI Summer Institute (grades 3 to 9) and enrichment (early childhood to grade 2)
Six week summer program (age 2 to grade 9), weekly sessions

refund_policy_summary: No refunds after May 1 for changes in plans; for health reasons the camp tries another session first, and gives a full refund with a medical provider's note.
